title: DAYBREAK // KILLHOUSE
summary: A bright Three.js horde shooter with a carbine and pump shotgun.
description: A daytime tactical arena FPS built by Grok 4.7 through Grok CLI. Features a carbine with red-dot aiming, a pump shotgun, enemy waves, weapon swapping, reloading, procedural effects, synthesized audio and a HUD-hide control for recording.
